title: Standardized emergency supply points and inspection
summary: We designate emergency supply points in every construction area stocked with specific equipment and mandate monthly inspections by the HSE department.

content.overview: We maintain standardized emergency material stations across the site to guarantee immediate access to first aid and rescue equipment. Each point holds a defined kit, and the HSE department verifies and replenishes supplies on the 1st of every month.
content.details: Standard inventory per point: first aid kit (including tourniquets, burn cream, eye wash), 2 sets of positive-pressure SCBA, 10 chemical cartridge respirators, emergency lighting, and a stretcher. We chose this specific list based on common site injury profiles and the need for immediate self-rescue capability until professional responders arrive. Monthly inspections on a fixed date enforce stock accountability; any missing or expired items must be replaced same day.
content.examples: Inspection checklist for 1st March: count SCBA sets, check pressure gauges, verify expiration of burn cream, test emergency lights, sign off.
content.references: Site HSE plan, equipment maintenance log.
content.caveats: SCBA cylinders must be hydrotested periodically. Emergency lights require quarterly battery discharge cycles. Relying solely on monthly checks may miss consumption between inspections; users should report usage immediately.
